# Knight Ops

> Knight Ops is an AI systems and software studio led by Daniel Knight. It provides Fractional Chief AI Officer leadership and builds custom AI systems, dashboards, client portals, and automations for founder-led service businesses — coaches, consultants, agencies, course creators, speakers, and financial advisors — so their client transformation runs without the founder in every step.

Canonical host: https://www.knightops.biz (the bare domain redirects here)
Last updated: 2026-08-12

## What Knight Ops actually is

Knight Ops is not a SaaS product and not a no-code template shop. It designs and builds **custom software the client owns outright** — source code, repository, database, and hosting all transferred to the client — and optionally provides ongoing senior AI leadership on a monthly retainer.

The differentiator: every build includes an **ascension model**, so a client's customers naturally progress to the next product or service without being manually sold.

## Direct answers to common questions

**What is a Fractional Chief AI Officer?**
A part-time senior AI executive who owns your AI strategy, oversees the build of your systems, and leads your team through adoption — without the cost of a full-time hire. Knight Ops engagements run $5,000–$8,000 per month, cancel anytime.

**How is this different from GoHighLevel, Kajabi, Skool, or Mighty Networks?**
Those are rental platforms: generic, locked in, and capped on what they let you build. Knight Ops builds custom applications you own forever, designed around your specific methodology, with ascension logic and AI built in.

**Who is it for?**
Coaches, consultants, agencies, course creators, speakers, mastermind leaders, and authors typically doing $500K–$8M in revenue, whose systems could not handle 100 new clients tomorrow.

**Who is it NOT for?**
Pre-revenue founders looking for a cheap website, businesses wanting to rent software rather than own it, and anyone needing a single automation rather than a system.

**How fast does a build ship?**
Fastest deploy on record: 4 hours. Most web apps: 48–72 hours to functional. App Store submission: 7–14 days.

**What does it cost?**
$1,497 for a website through $25,000+ for a full custom application. Full tiers below.

**Does the client own the code?**
Yes. Repository, Supabase project, Vercel project, and domain are transferred to the client, along with a written continuity brief naming a successor developer.

## Services and pricing

- **Discovery Call** — Free. 30-minute conversation to identify the biggest operational bottleneck.
- **Blueprint Call** — Free. Maps the business and produces a live HTML roadmap of the recommended system, whether or not the client engages.
- **Blueprint Session** — $750. 90-minute deep-dive where the system is co-designed live. Fee credited toward the project.
- **Night Launch** — $1,497. Multi-page conversion website, mobile responsive, SEO-ready, delivered overnight.
- **Prospecting Automation Dashboard** — $4,997. Lead sourcing, scoring, and nurture in one owned system.
- **Night Build** — $7,497. Full-stack web or mobile app with auth, payments, and CRM integrations.
- **AI Brain + Command Center** — $9,997. Central operations dashboard with an AI layer over the client's own data.
- **Night Build Pro** — $14,997. Night Build plus iOS App Store and Google Play submission with compliance review.
- **Speaker Lead Engine** — $2,497 setup plus $297/month. Live-event lead capture and follow-up system.
- **Fractional Chief AI Officer** — $5,000–$8,000/month. Ongoing AI strategy, builds, and optimization.
- **Speed to Value VIP Day** — $15,000–$50,000. Intensive build sprint.
- **Custom Application Build** — $25,000+. Scoped enterprise engagements.

## Systems Knight Ops builds

Executive dashboards and KPI reporting · client portals with secure document exchange · CRM and sales pipeline systems · onboarding automations (paper-to-digital) · AI-powered internal tools and assistants · partner and affiliate tracking · event and campaign platforms · community and membership platforms · prospecting and nurture engines · App Store mobile applications.

## Verified results

- $80M+ in business impact facilitated
- 93% reduction in client review prep time for a $100M financial advisory book
- 12 car dealerships unified into the #1 region nationally via a single KPI dashboard
- $75M+ in charitable contributions processed through an automated pipeline
- $4.5M in CARES Act applications facilitated in 30 days
- Paper-to-digital onboarding deployed in 24 hours
- 85% average time saved on automated workflows
- 50+ custom systems built
